book.name: MATEU
book.title: Eliywi no kuwaba lya Jesu Kilesite eli lina kun̄oliwa kwa MATEU

content: Okwinguka kwa Jesu
Munyima no liywaa no Sabata, elino matatekelo mu sunda amasikusiku aba lina kupa, Maliya Magadalena ni Maliya munjili, sebeli ata muku mona ku libita.
Ababo sebeli kwikala ezikinyeho inene luli, kakuli elingeloi no Mbumu na likutunda kuwilu ni kwiiya muku pikulusa eliwee ba libita, ni kwikala ba liwee.
Kame lina kumonahala kanyi olumonyi no mbula, ni ikumango yalyo no likena kanyi elitwaa.
Atateleli sebeli acila ni kukun̄a, mi sebeli amonahala kanyi omunu no kufa mulibaka no kumona elingeloi.
Elingeloi sebeli lyamba kwakati nji, “Mulese kucila,” “Kame ni limukile nji kame musaela Jesu onaku ngongotelwa ba sifapano.
Ka sako kuno, kakuli Nyambe na mwingula kwaafu, kanyi omu ana kwambela Jesu. Ko mwiye mumone mu sibaka ana ku langana.
Cwale mute mu lelube, mi mu kambele aiyetwa aye nji, ‘Nyambe namwingula kwaafu, mi kame akatile balubala lwenu okuta ku Galileya, okoko kwa samu ka mumone. Aa amaywi nineyele muku myambela.”
Cwale sebeli atunda muwangu ku libita acilile ni kuwabelwa onene, sebeli aituka nu kambela aiyetwa aye.
Cwale aba ana taanga mukwambela aiyetwa aye, Jesu sebeli okuwana noo ni kwa keeta mi sebeli aiya kwa yonyene, ni kumulema ku makondo ni kumulapela.
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Mulese ku cila,” “Mute mukambele abaange nji ate ku Galileya kwasa kani mone.”
Elin̄usa no Atateleli
Ababo akati akatile, atateleli anjiili sebeli ata mu mulenen̄i okabihela apulisita akulu eyi ina tendahala yonje.
Cwale apulisita akulu nakulu sebeli akuwana ni kulelisana. Sebeli aba amasole amali no kupula,
ni kwaambela nji, “Mwambe nji, aiyetwa aye kame aneyi ousiku, mi naiiti olutu lwaye, aci metu langanine.
Nji omubusisi aba sa yupe etaba eyo, mba tu mu kolwisa, ni kumi tundisa mu utata.”
Cwale sebeli ashimba amali ni kutenda kanyi omo anaku laelelwa. Mi etaba eyi nai kuhasana mukaci no Majuda mi isambiwa ni balelo lino.
Jesu yo Kumonahaza kwa Iyetwa aye
Cwale aiyetwa ana kukwana likumi ni mu mweya (11) sebeli ata ku Galileya, ku lilundu elyo ana kwasimweta Jesu.
Cwale aba ana kumu mona, sebeli amu kubamena, kono anjili alimbululile.
Cwale Jesu sebeli oiya kwa onyene ni kwaambela nji, “Etukelo yonje namu wilu ni mu litunga kame ina biwe kwa mene.
Mute cwale mu katende aiyeti no macaba onje, mwa kolobeze mu litina lya Sitange, ni lya Mwana, neli no Mebo No Kukena.
Mi mwaiyete oku mamela einu yonje nina milaelele. Mi mupuluke nji, kame nili nenu mu nako yonje, okutwala ku mamaneneno no litunga.”
